title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Statement Minimum Payment by Phone on a Revolving Account
content:
When an owner, principal or authorized buyer of a business holding a revolving Pro Credit account asks to make the payment that satisfies the latest statement's minimum, the payment is one debit from the business's bank account by phone ACH, authorized and submitted by the business itself.

A minimum-satisfying payment is recorded as one payment line held on account under its payment reference, and it is applied on the next statement.

## Scope

This card covers the revolving tiers of Ridgeline Pro Credit — the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge and Pro Revolving Charge Plus. The payment is the minimum-satisfying payment for the account's latest statement, debited once from the business's bank account.

## When the payment is fixed

The minimum-satisfying payment is fixed only after the most recent late fee on the account, when it stands above its re-rated amount, carries a correction entry on the ledger.

## The payment

The payment is made with the task tool `submit_minimum_payment_92c17bdd`, which belongs to the business: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, handing it over, and the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool` to authorize and submit the debit.

**Capability.** One call debits the business's bank account once by phone ACH, credits one payment line to the Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account today, held on account under a new payment confirmation reference, and lowers the account's current balance by the amount paid. The business sees the payment and its confirmation reference in the account's activity.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account being paid, as read out by the agent from the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `payment_amount` | The amount debited from the business's bank account | USD, a positive number rounded to 2 decimal places; debited exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "credited", `trade_transaction_id` (the reference number of the new payment line), `payment_reference` (the phone payment confirmation reference, text beginning PM-), `payment_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `transaction_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `current_balance` (the account balance after the payment, USD, 2 decimal places). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.
